description: Réseau d'Initiative Publique "la fibre Grand Lyon" is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. This layer of lines corresponds to the route of the fibre optic cables of the Réseau d'Initiative Publique (RIP) "La fibre Grand Lyon". Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The portal shows the English title as "Network of Public Initiative "La fibre Grand Lyon"" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole de Lyon. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, CSV, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
